title: Best Buy launches in-game experience on Fortnite
summary: Inside the store, players can unlock exclusive in-game gear, play mini-games and earn XP.
body_markdown:
By[Best Buy](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/)


August 20, 2026


**Key Highlights**


- **Visit Best Buy on Fortnite:** starting Aug. 20, gamers can use island codes to visit a Best Buy store in Fortnite’s Drive City.


- **Unlock gear and XP** **:** players that


visit Drive City can


return Best Buy Tags


to


access


XP and the Best Buy Grappler.


It’s official: a new season of Fortnite kicks off today, and Best Buy is opening a virtual store for gamers. Through Drive City, one of Fortnite’s open-world roleplay experiences, players can visit a Best Buy store, explore different departments and take on a special Best Buy quest.


Inside the store, players can unlock exclusive in-game gear, play mini-games and earn XP.


## **Exclusive Best Buy Experience**


As the new Fortnite season begins, players can find in-game experiences and mini games to level up their game even more. To complete the Best Buy quest, players can:


- Search the Drive City map for collectible Best Buy Tags and bring them back to the Best Buy employee at the store.


- Return 10 Best Buy Tags to earn a Best Buy Back Bling plus in-game currency and XP.


- Return 20 Best Buy Tags and earn the Best Buy Grappler, which stays with you across play sessions.


The store also features a photo booth that helps players locate nearby collectibles, a Geek Squad area and a boom box that lets players control the music while they shop.


## **Access Best Buy on Fortnite**


Ready to get gaming? Open Fortnite on a mobile phone, Nintendo Switch, PC or other console. Select Search and enter one of the island codes below to access Best Buy on Fortnite:


- Drive City: 6246-3089-1172


- Meet Up (Proximity Chat): 3527-4959-6539


- Toy Box: 9061-5458-7889


*Visit*[BestBuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/) *to for more information about all things gaming.*


## FAQs


## Q: When will the Best Buy store be live on Fortnite?


A: S tarting Aug. 20, gamers can use one of the island codes to visit the Best Buy store in Fortnite’s Drive City.


## Q: How do I visit the Best Buy on Fortnite?


A:


The Best Buy is located in Fortnite’s Drive City, an open-world roleplay experience, where players can walk in, explore the departments and take on a Best Buy quest.


Gamers can use the first code to access Drive City, and the remaining three to access a Best Buy Only Up mini game in Meet Up and Toy Box FFA maps:


- Drive City: 6246-3089-1172


- Meet Up (Proximity Chat): 3527-4959-6539


- Toy Box: 9061-5458-7889


## Q: What can I do at the Best Buy?


A: Gamers who visit the Best Buy store can find in-game experiences and mini games on a TV in the store, win XP or potential loot.


For more information about RGB LED TVs at Best Buy, visit


[BestBuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/tv-home-theater/learn-about-rgb-led-tvs/pcmcat1774379203427.c?id=pcmcat1774379203427) .


*1 Source: Circana, LLC, Retail Tracking Service, Unit Sales, 52 WE Jan 9, 2021*
